name: Grace Of The Lord Jesus Christ
overview: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ is the unmerited gift of salvation that God provides to sinners, not earned by works but given through faith. Scripture reveals that while sin leads to death, eternal life is freely given through Jesus Christ (Romans 6:23). Believers are united with Christ, living by faith in His love and sacrifice (Galatians 2:20), and are saved by God's mercy through spiritual renewal rather than human righteousness (Titus 3:5). This grace is the foundation of salvation, emphasizing that it is God's gift alone that brings deliverance (Ephesians 2:8).
